Dream interpretation 1789 views Q. Dream 1271 views Q. As Salaamu Alaikum. I had a dream and would like to have it interpreted Insha Allah. I was in a house with about 5 other people both male and female, I don't think any were Muslim except for me. Something broke and 2 went to the basement to fix it, while down there, the house exploded and everyone died. In my dream we were re-created and taken back to the time before the explosion without clear memory of what was to happen. We were reading a book with stories and it became clear to me that the book was reminding me what was going to happen. I knew it was the Will of Allah SWT so I didn't fight it or try to convince other people. Instead, when I recognised the time approaching for the explosion I rushed to make wudhu & make salah as I wanted to die in a state of salah. At the time of the explosion, nothing happened. I finished my prayer and went to see the other people. One man who had gone downstairs to fix the problem(as in the beginning) smiled at me and showed me his hand which was burnt. Can you please tell me what this means? May Allah SWT reward you for your time and effort. 1609 views Q. علمائے دیوبند کے اکابر سے میں بہت متأثر ہوں اور میں ان کی تعریف کرتاہوں۔ میرا سوال یہ ہے کہ نہج البلاغة کی معتبریت کیا ہے؟کچھ لوگ کہتے ہیں کہ قرآن کریم کے بعد یہ سب سے زیادہ معتبر اور مستند ہے۔ کیا آپ تفصیل سے اس کی وضاحت کرسکتے ہیں؟ 1586 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 46810 Country: India Title: Isthikhara dream interpretation Question: I have done engineering but could not get a job. My hobby is photography and I have applied for photography course in a university and I did istikharah for it. I asked whether I should go for photography or not because if I go for photography course it will be difficult to return back to engineering. In my dreams I saw 2-3 children asking me what I am holding in my hand, and when I saw my hand, I was holding a camera with me. Suddenly then I was at another place, I as wearing white kurta pajama and all people around me were wearing white dress probably white kurta pajama. But I did not remember whether I was attending a marriage or funeral ceremony. Please interpret my dream. Answer ID: 46810 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1060/813/D=9/1434) Photography is unlawful and sin. Hadith warns sternly against it. Do not do this course. You should search any suitable job based on your engineering course. In-shaAllah, it shall bring prosperity and blessings. One sees in dream the things which linger in mind as wandering thoughts. Hence you should not worry to know its meaning. You should follow the Shariah ruling we have mentioned. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
